snippet.title: Apex Legends x Cyberpunk Event Trailer
snippet.description:
Welcome to the Apex Legends x Cyberpunk Event, where the neon lights of E-District beckon in Wildcard and Cyberware floods the streets. But be careful: reports of Cyberpsychosis are on the rise. Hunt down the Mythic Skippy Alternator and Iconic Legend skins, and earn Eddies throughout the event to spend in the Reward Shop.

The Apex Legends x Cyberpunk Event goes live July 14.

Learn more: http://x.ea.com/apxl/cyberpunk-event

Apex Legends™ is a free-to-play* battle royale game where legendary characters battle for glory, fame, and fortune on the fringes of the Frontier. Play for free now on PlayStation®4, PlayStation®5, Xbox® One, Xbox Series X|S, Nintendo Switch™ 2, and PC via EA App, Epic Games Store and Steam: http://x.ea.com/57366.

Check out our YouTube channel: http://x.ea.com/56710
Follow us on X: https://twitter.com/playapex
Follow us on Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/playapex/

snippet.title: Ve Junoon | Awarapan 2 | Emraan Hashmi, Disha Patani | Vishesh Bhatt | Mithoon, Sayeed Q., Subodhh
snippet.description:
Phir ishq karne chala kyun?
 
Beginning the musical journey of ‘Awarapan 2’, ‘Ve Junoon’ is composed by Mithoon, sung by Subodhh Sharma and penned by Sayeed Quadri. Featuring Emraan Hashmi and Disha Patani in the video, this song is yearning in its purest form.
 
#VeJunoon #Awarapan2 #EmraanHashmi #DishaPatani #Mithoon #SayeedQuadri #SubodhhSharma
 
Song Composed and Arranged by Mithoon
Lyrics: Sayeed Quadri
Singer: Subodhh Sharma
Song Creative Head: Anugrah
Music Production: Godswill Mergulhão
Music Assistants: Anugrah, Godswill Mergulhão, Eli Rodrigues & Kaushal Gohil
Guitars: Kalyan Baruah
Violin: Jitu Thakur
Backing Vocals: Abhishek Nailwal, Mihir Sharma & Kaustubh More
Recorded at Livingwater Music by A Manivannan
Song Mixed & Mastered by Eric Pillai at Future Sound of Bombay
Assistant Mixing Engineer: Michael Edwin Pillai
Music Head Vishesh Films: Rohit Saini
 
Starring Emraan Hashmi, Disha Patani, Shabana Azmi, Suvinder Vicky, Vijayant Kohli, Aniruddh Rawal, Atul Kumar
 
Vishesh Films & Mukesh Bhatt Present
A Vishesh Bhatt Production
 
AWARAPAN 2
Produced By Vishesh Bhatt
Directed By Nitin Kakkar
Director of Photography Vishnu Rao
Editor Devendra Murdeshwar
Production Designer Teena Paradkar
Choreographer Mudassar Khan
 
Theatrical Distribution Pen Marudhar
In Cinemas 14th August 2026
 
Lyrics:

Intro
 
Chaha tha tune jisse Paaya kabhi na usse
 
Tujhko toh sab hai pataa, aye dil Saari khabar hai tujhe
 
Banjar hui hai aankhen Veeran hai ye saansen
Ab meri rooh ko na jalaa...naa jalaa
 
Aage hai teri marzi Karle tu ye khudgarzi
Hona hai hojaa tabaah...haan tabaah
 
Chorus
 
Ve Junoon, Ve Junoon, Ve Junoon, Ve Junoon, Ve Junoon Dil lutne chalaa kyun
 
Ve Junoon, Ve Junoon, Ve Junoon, Ve Junoon, Ve Junoon Dil mitne chalaa kyun..haaye
 
Phir Ishq karne chalaa kyun OOOOOOOOO..
Dil lutne chalaa kyun OOOOOOOOO..
Dil mitne chalaa kyun..haaye Phir Ishq karne chala kyun…
 
( Music )
 
OOOOOOOOOO.. OOOOOOOOOO..
 
Verse 1
 
Dekha hai pehle kahin Aisa laga kyun usse
 
Shaayad mere dard se kahin Waqif laga woh mujhe
 
Marham laga zakhmon pe Raahat mili kuchh phirse
Dil ko sukoon milaa..haan milaaaa
 
Aage hai teri marzi Karle tu ye khudgarzi
Hona hai hojaa tabaah...haan tabaah
 
Chorus
 
Ve Junoon, Ve Junoon, Ve Junoon, Ve Junoon, Ve Junoon Dil lutne chalaa kyun
 
Ve Junoon, Ve Junoon, Ve Junoon, Ve Junoon, Ve Junoon Dil mitne chalaa kyun, haaye
 
Phir Ishq karne chalaa kyun…
 
(Music)
 
Tararareiyeee yeeeeee…
 
Verse 2
 
Aisi koi daastaan
Hai dil main uske kahin Zikr woh jiska kabhi magar Khud se bhi karta nahin
 
Rakhta chhupa ke sabse Bhulaa hai jaise rakh ke
Kal woh kahin apna…..apnaaa Aage hai teri marzi
 
Karle tu ye khudgarzi
Hona hai hojaa tabaah...haan tabaah
 
Chorus
 
Ve Junoon, Ve Junoon, Ve Junoon, Ve Junoon, Ve Junoon Dil lutne chalaa kyun
 
Ve Junoon, Ve Junoon, Ve Junoon, Ve Junoon, Ve Junoon Dil mitne chalaa kyun….haaye
 
Phir ishq karne chalaa kyun
 
Ve Junooooooooooooooo Oooooooooo Oooooooooo Ooooooooooo
Ve Junooooooooooooooo Oooooooooo Oooooooooo Ooooooooooo
 
Dil ishq karne chalaa kyun Hmmmmmm…..
Phir ishq karne chalaa kyun

snippet.title: Dinosaurs of the Wild West | Official Kickstarter Trailer (4K)
snippet.description:
Worldwide Pre-Order on Kickstarter Now: https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/sparkefilms/dinosaurs-of-the-wild-west-series

From the creative team behind the 2025 cult-dinosaur feature PRIMITIVE WAR comes an ambitious new original cinematic universe: DINOSAURS OF THE WILD WEST.

In an alternate frontier, humanity navigates a dangerous land where every journey, every town, and every war depends on the giant creatures that shaped civilization itself. Dinosaurs of the Wild West is an epic adventure series that reimagines the American frontier through a world millions of years in the making.

Massive Brontosaurs haul entire towns across the frontier.
Raptors are ridden into battle.
Pterosaurs rule the skies.

For generations, humans and dinosaurs shaped the world together.
Now something is coming that threatens to change that forever.

Narrated by actor Jesse Kove. Inspired by the illustrated world of creator Shaun Keenan. 

Alongside the full trailer, DINOSAURS OF THE WILD WEST Kickstarter campaign unveils  a mix of EARLY BIRD and LIMITED EDITION rewards that include:
 VIP ON SET EXPERIENCES
 FIRST EDITION TRADING CARD SET
 BEHIND THE SCENES ACCESS
 ASSOCIATE PRODUCER CREDITS
 And the opportunity to CREATE A DINOSAUR for the series.

Stretch goals for the campaign include expanded creature sequences, additional cinematic set pieces, major guest appearances, and the unlocking of future episodes. 

Currently the ONLY way to watch is to pre order the series through kickstarter. 

ABOUT THE PROJECT
Dinosaurs of the Wild West is an original cinematic universe created by filmmaker Luke Sparke and developed alongside a team of artists and visual effects talent behind Primitive War and multiple internationally released feature films. It’s produced by Carmel Imrie, Carly Sparke and Luke Sparke with Executive Producers Geoff Imrie, Eric Weick, Colin Hurdle, Kelly Clifford, Luke Sparke

The two promos were completed in house by Luke Sparke, Sparke Films, Let It Be Entertainment and Sparke Effects including VFX artists Vivian David, Jared Johnson, Mark Griffiths, Julien Romeo, Felipe Gonzalez, Evan Robinson, Alejandro Agudelo and in conjunction with Kubo vfx studio. VFX Supervison by Luke Sparke, Post Produced by Carly Sparke, Executive Creative Brooke Marsden and original score by Frederik Wiedmann.

TikTok: @primitivewarmovie
Facebook:  @primitivewarmovie

snippet.description:
The Sallowlands beckon—immerse yourself into the world and characters of this new Daggerheart mini-series premiering July 9th! Rumors swirl of a gargantuan metropolis appearing suddenly, deep in the cracked ancient lakebed of the Sallowlands. Five survivors hope that finding it will give them what they each desperately need.

AGE OF UMBRA: SALLOWLANDS
A group of outcasts and survivors brave blasted lands in search of answers in Age of Umbra: Sallowlands. This 6-part Daggerheart mini-series features Game Master Matthew Mercer and players Laura Bailey, Jennifer English, Abubakar Salim, Vico Ortiz, and Zachery Renauldo. They’ll form an unlikely band of companions, who venture off the beaten path in search of answers in the Sallowlands, a new region of the Halcyon Domain filled with cracked badlands, dangers, and awe-inspiring secrets. What fragile hopes dare they cling to in this story of desperation and survival? Learn more at https://critrole.com/umbra

YRF Spy Universe is a first of its kind cinematic universe of spy thriller films in India. The first film in the universe, "Ek Tha Tiger", starring Salman Khan and Katrina Kaif was released in 2012, followed by its sequel "Tiger Zinda Hai" in 2017. The third film in the universe, "War" was released in 2019 and starred Hrithik Roshan and Tiger Shroff in pivotal roles. "Alpha", the seventh film in the franchise and Hindi cinema’s first female-led YRF Spy Universe film, starring Alia Bhatt and Sharvari, released on 3 July 2026.

snippet.title: FORGOTTEN ISLAND Trailer 2 (NEW 2026) 4K
snippet.description:
Official Website: www.ForgottenIslandMovie.com

Forgotten Island - In Theaters September 25.

Your best friendship is worth fighting for.

DreamWorks Animation, the studio that brought you unforgettable bonds between a boy and a dragon in How to Train Your Dragon, an ogre and a donkey in Shrek, and a robot and a gosling in The Wild Robot, now welcomes a dazzling and emotional story about two lifelong best friends who must come together before they drift apart in Forgotten Island. 

The new original film is written and directed by Academy Award® nominee Joel Crawford and Januel Mercado and is produced by Academy Award® nominee Mark Swift, the filmmaking team behind Puss in Boots: The Last Wish. 

Grammy and Academy Award® winning supernova H.E.R. and Liza Soberano (Lisa Frankenstein, Alone/Together) star as high school graduates Jo and Raissa, who have been best friends since grade school but are now about to embark on separate life paths. 

While celebrating their last night together, Jo and Raissa stumble upon a mysterious portal that transports them to the fantastical island of Nakali, packed with magical and mythological creatures they grew up hearing stories about from their Filipino families.  
Some of these figures will become friends, some foes. Joined by well-meaning-but- hapless weredog Raww (Dave Franco) and a small-but-mighty pack of pals, Jo and Raissa must face The Dreaded Manananggal (Tony winning icon Lea Salonga), the most feared creature on the island. When they discover that the memories of their entire friendship are the price for returning home, Jo and Raissa will race to find a way to leave the island before they forget each other forever. 
The film’s all-star voice cast also includes Emmy nominee Jenny Slate (Marcel the Shell with Shoes On, Dying for Sex), Manny Jacinto (The Good Place, Top Gun: Maverick), BAFTA nominee Dolly de Leon (Triangle of Sadness, Ghostlight), global comedy superstar Jo Koy (Haunted Mansion, Jo Koy: Live from Brooklyn) and Emmy winner Ronny Chieng (The Daily Show, M3GAN).  

DreamWorks Animation’s Forgotten Island is distributed by Universal Pictures. 

SUBSCRIBE for more ANIMATED videos here: www.youtube.com/@JoBloAnimatedVideos?sub_confirmation=1

Footage Courtesy Of NBCUniversal Media, LLC.

The film’s all-star voice cast also includes Emmy nominee Jenny Slate (Marcel the Shell with Shoes On, Dying for Sex), Manny Jacinto (The Good Place, Top Gun: Maverick), BAFTA nominee Dolly de Leon (Triangle of Sadness, Ghostlight), global comedy superstar Jo Koy (Haunted Mansion, Jo Koy: Live from Brooklyn) and Emmy winner Ronny Chieng (The Daily Show, M3GAN).

A heartfelt dancehall breakup anthem about two lovers watching a once beautiful relationship fall apart. Love Done Dead blends modern dancehall, reggae fusion, and soulful Caribbean melodies into an emotional story filled with regret, memories, and feelings that never truly disappear.




Popcaan and Shenseea deliver emotional performances as two hearts struggle to let go after love fades. With honest storytelling, relatable lyrics, and a memorable singalong chorus, Love Done Dead captures the pain of missing someone who was once your everything.




Perfect for late night listening, heartbreak playlists, emotional moments, and lovers of smooth Caribbean music.

• Emotional breakup storytelling

PLUS, join us as we head behind the scenes for an in-depth look at exactly how we create our terrestrial species for Planet Zoo 2, discover what's changed in the years since the original Planet Zoo and learn just what makes these animals such a leap forward!

Soar to great heights with flying birds, prepare your diving suits as fully-aquatic species make a splash, and take your conservation efforts beyond your zoo in brand-new Wildlife Reserves!

snippet.title: NEW LEAK says Sony SHOCKED by Backlash! No Plan for FUTURE OF PLAYSTATION!
snippet.description:
Follow me on social media:
Instagram: http://instagram.com/dreamcastguy
Patreon: patreon.com/DreamcastGuy
Twitch: https://www.twitch.tv/thedreamcastguy

Sony announced they're done with physical games starting in 2028. 

There's a pretty good chance I won't be getting the PS6 at this point 
#PlayStation6 #PS6 #ps5 


The complete disregard and disrespect for the fans who care deeply about physical PS games might be the biggest slap to the face I've see from this company. Absolute joke. As consumer preferences and the broader entertainment industry continue to shift away from physical discs to digital, physical game disc production for all new games releasing on PlayStation consoles will be discontinued starting January 2028.  Following this date, new games will be available on PlayStation Store and at retailers in digital formats only. This transition has no impact on games that already released, or will be releasing, prior to January 2028 in disc format. Kojima has spoken in Rome about the end of PlayStation's physical format: I think PlayStation executives are so out of touch if they didn’t realize how bad this new would go down amongst some of their most hardcore fans. I was so shocked when they dropped the news just like everyone else.

I hope they can figure out something to make the situation better and not just ignore some of their most dedicated fans

"It makes me very sad, I'm buying lots of PS3 games so they don't get lost" this might genuinely be one of the biggest Gaming protest/drama/boycott ever to exist for a long time And you will see Sony hide behind today's Xbox news. This is where we are people. One greedy company hiding behind another greedy company's bad news to avoid addressing their own. It has now been 6 days since the PlayStation post: PlayStation hasn't posted in over 5 days on Twitter (X) 🎮

• Their longest span of not tweeting in years

• The post announcing they're ending physical game production currently has 8 approved Community Notes

- it's official the 4th most viewed biggest gaming post ever on Twitter/X (164m views, 1-3 are GTA 6 posts)
- SONY wanted to wait this out but people are not willing to forget
- This had created a Cultural phenomenon around the world
- More people than ever are speaking out on it

SONY messed up bad here, there is no alternative than to respond. No one will forget THIS!!! Xbox really just fired over 3 thousand ppl and sold off at least 4 of their 1st party studios, and it's still not as bad as that shit PlayStation announced last week. What a world. REPORT: PlayStation has apparently blindsided, and not told its publishers and business partners, and even branches in other markets, about cancelling physical games🚀

Sony reducing a legacy spanning multiple generations to mere three paragraph blog post that implies utter disdain for its audience is deranged to say the least🎤 

NO DISC 💿 NO BUY

snippet.title: My Thoughts On PlayStation Ending Physical Discs
snippet.description:
Sony has announced they're ending the production of physical discs for PlayStation consoles by January 2028. And while they have made it clear that reprints could occur, there's simply no getting around this being the end of what was such a core part of the hobby. And in the midst of all this, there's arguments about physical vs. digital splits, publisher desire, profits, used games, and the WHY of Sony is doing this. I'm here to argue, it's less about that. Numbers are numbers, but sometimes you do something as a goodwill initiative. And PlayStation has forgotten what it means to do something for the brand and the wider fandom. They just don't get it anymore. I also never understood the plot of Inception. But we're not here for that.

snippet.title: THE ZOMBIE-PROOF WALL IS BACK | 7 Days to Die 3.0
snippet.description:
The Zombie-Proof Wall is back in 7 Days to Die 3.0.

This time, it works using a new block I discovered that tricks zombies into walking in place without damaging the wall at all.

It holds them completely still, stops them from breaking through, and can be built incredibly cheaply compared to most horde base setups.

It’s the same classic Zombie-Proof Wall idea, but rebuilt for 3.0 with a new block that makes the whole thing easier than ever.

Zombies can see you. Zombies can path to you. Zombies can try to reach you.

They just can’t do anything about it.

Info about the map written by oxygendavid
Welcome to Witcombe Park Farm
📍 Inspired by the countryside of Gloucestershire, UK

🌄 A carefully crafted blend of real‑world geography and fictional design, creating a distinctive and authentic UK farming landscape.
🚜 60+ fields ranging from small paddocks to large arable expanses.
🗺️ 100+ purchasable farmlands, including extensive forestry plots and hidden woodland corners.
🐇 New animal: Rabbits
🐖🐄🐑 New British livestock breeds, each with their own stats: • Gloucestershire Old Spot (pigs) • Hereford & Jersey (cattle) • Suffolk, Bluefaced Leicester & Texel (sheep)
🌦️ Fully reworked environment XML featuring new weather patterns, lighting profiles, cloud systems, and a refreshed daytime skybox.
🌱 Completely redesigned UK style ground textures and foliage, giving the map a fresh, grounded visual identity. 🚂 Driveable Class 40 (UK) 🇬🇧 Step into the cab of a fully driveable British Rail Class 40 and experience true UK diesel‑electric power in action! 🔧⚡
Fire up the engine, take the controls, and enjoy driving one of Britain’s most iconic locomotives right inside the game. 🚆✨ Who’s taking it for a spin first 😄
🌲 High detail forest assets for a more realistic woodland experience.
🎧 Custom ambient soundscape tailored to the map’s environment.
🚗 New UK‑style traffic, including motorbikes, tractors, and articulated lorries.
🏡 4 fully developed main farms, each with their own character.
🏘️ 4+ small holdings, offering varied and immersive starting points.
🛠️ Full customization sellable farm buildings, removable junk piles, adjustable field borders, and more.
🎮 Designed to support every playstyle  from small scale realism to large scale contracting.

Multi Terrain Angle added 
🌾 14 New Crops Added 
📦 From PfalzAgrar Multi Prefab Pack (10):
Rye • Triticale • Spelt • Grain Maize • Green Rye • Vetch Rye • Field Grass • Silage Maize • Humus Activator • Mustard

🌼 Custom Crops (3):
Alfalfa • Linseed • Poppy

🏭 7 custom production chains integrated seamlessly into the map.
🍎 4 dedicated fruit sell points
🏪 10 additional sell points for productions, materials, and goods.
🧱 30+ new UK‑themed placeables
🏘️ Hundreds of high‑detail UK assets populating the world.


Music by Epidemic Sound
